raw_segments.text: I was not surprised, when I ran down into the hall, to see that a brilliant June morning
had succeeded to the tempest of the night, and to feel, through the open glass door,
the breathing of a fresh and fragrant breeze. Nature must be gladsome when I was so happy.
A beggar woman and her little boy, pale, ragged objects both, were coming up the walk, and
I ran down and gave them all the money I happened to have in my purse, some three or four shillings.
Good or bad, they must partake of my jubilee.
The rook's cod and blither bird sang, but nothing was so merry or so musical as my own rejoicing heart.
